author: opencode-worker-3
text: SCOPED (worker-3, released — the full fix needs an oracle schema change, 90+ min): (1) CONFIRMED bypasses: Rust rpl_route_state_vectors.rs:328+ vector loop uses process_route_state_diagnostic (ungated; its own comment admits it) — note the GATED path process_signature_verified IS exercised at :481+ for the canonical tests, only the GROUPED vectors bypass; Python dao_vectors.py:139-142 uses evaluate_dao_semantics_for_test_at (allow_unauthenticated_test=True, source_address=None -> the 8.6 gate steps 2-3 skipped). (2) BLOCKER: the oracle's delegations array is keyed by ORIGIN ADDRESS (02001122...) with NO key material — the C gate (lichen_rpl_prefix_delegate) is address-keyed, while the Rust PrefixDelegations and the Python origin_validator are PUBKEY-keyed per spec 8.6 ('Replay state is keyed by the pinned 32-octet public key'). The consumers cannot reconstruct the origin keys from the JSON alone. (3) DIVERGENCE TO RESOLVE FIRST (bigger than the wiring): the C delegation gate keys by ORIGIN ADDRESS while spec 8.6 mandates pubkey-keyed replay — file/confirm with Mark whether the C's address-keyed lichen_rpl_prefix_delegate contract is itself a spec divergence (or an address->pubkey binding exists elsewhere). (4) FIX SHAPE: extend generate_rpl_route_state.py to store the origin seeds/pubkeys in the delegations array, regenerate rpl_route_state.json, then Rust: delegate_prefix(pubkey,...) + re-sign each vector DAO via signed_dao + drive process_signature_verified in the grouped loop; Python: pin keys + origin_validator + source_address=origin in run_route_state_vectors; expectations unchanged (same accepted/state_changed). (5) The vectors' dao_hex are UNSIGNED (no 0x12) — the runner signs them.
